tasks.label: Check Competitive House Districts
tasks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('inputs/house_race_inputs.csv')
df['distance_to_50'] = (df['dem_win_probability'] - 0.5).abs()
cols = [
    'district_id',
    'dem_candidate',
    'gop_candidate',
    'district_partisan_baseline_dem',
    'district_environment_adjustment_dem',
    'incumbency_adjustment_dem',
    'fundamentals_margin_dem',
    'dem_win_probability',
]
print(df.sort_values('distance_to_50')[cols].head(30).to_string(index=False))
PY
